name: Band-stop filter

semantics.definition: A filter response that attenuates a bounded band of frequencies while passing frequencies below and above that band.

evidence.claim: Documents a notch response selector in the EQ Eight interface.
Defines and illustrates band-stop or notch filtering as a frequency-response concept.
Provides related band-stop terminology and circuit-diagram symbols, not the target compact audio glyph.

notes: Whether notch filter remains an alias or needs a parameterized future entry is an open evidence question.
The representative glyph is a concept, not vendor artwork.
